newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila approves Kepphil expansion project.
newsitem.headline: Manila approves Kepphil expansion project.

text.p: The Philippines' Board of Investment (BoI) has approved a 450 million peso expansion project by Kepphil Shipyard Inc, documents released on Monday showed.
The expansion involves the construction of a graving dock with room for vessels of up to 40,000 dead weight tonnes (DWT) in its Batangas port, south of Manila.
At present, the company operates three floating docks which can accommodate between 5,000 and 20,000 dwt.
BoI approval entitles Kepphil to an income tax holiday and preferential tariff rates on its capital equipment imports.

To pay for the expansion, the company plans to source 80 million pesos from its internally generated funds, 100 million pesos from additional equity, 80 million pesos from the sale of a floating dock and the rest from bank loans.
Kepphil is a unit of Keppel Group of Singapore.
